links.outcome: Hallucinations and non-concordance of ChatGPT cancer screening information against USPSTF recommendations
links.effect: 43 of 60 (71.7%) criteria completely concordant; 14 (23.3%) not concordant or not present; hallucinations in 9 of 60 criteria (15%).
links.quote: ChatGPT hallucinations (i.e., completely made up, non-sensical or irrelevant information) were found in 9 of 60 criteria (15 %).

links.outcome: Concordance of AI clinical knowledge with current USPSTF screening guidelines
links.effect: 43 of 60 (71.7%) criteria completely concordant, 3 (5%) moderately concordant, 14 (23.3%) not concordant or not present; 9 of 14 non-concordant from oldest age group prompts.
links.quote: 43 of 60 (71.7 %) criteria were completely concordant, 3 (5 %) were moderately concordant and 14 (23.3 %) were not concordant or not present, with most of the non-concordant criteria (9 of 14, 64.3 %) being from prompts for the oldest age groups.

screen.reason: Evaluated ChatGPT's concordance with USPSTF cancer screening recommendations across standard prompts evaluated by expert scoring, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
